{"metadata":{"description":"DSH插件市场，自动更新，热重载插件，多种排序方案，快速管理和安装插件","id":"gh:1334022896","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-market","slug":"cyber-moshen/dsh-plugin-market","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","marketplace","open-source","plugin","plugin-market","web-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH插件市场，自动更新，热重载插件，多种排序方案，快速管理和安装插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @cyber-moshen/dsh-plugin-market"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Plugin Workshop** for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — a curated plugin catalog that lives in this v"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"Workshop** for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — a curated plugin catalog that lives in this very repo."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · 日本語"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A **Settings → Plugin Workshop (插件工坊)** page with:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- a **card grid** of community plugins — each card shows **tags** (click a tag to search it), **GitH"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ub stars**, **last-commit freshness** with a colored maintenance signal, and the **installed version"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" / update state**;
- **search across names, authors and tags**, plus an always-visible filter bar (i"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"nstalled state, sort by stars/commit, maintenance state);
- **one-click install / update** (runs the"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" real `dsh plugin` CLI in the background);
- a **GitHub icon button** on every card jumping straight"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" to the repo;
- a **settings modal** with a **GitHub Token** field (lifts API rate limits) and a **s"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"tartup auto-update** toggle;
- the **whole workshop follows the app's own language** (Settings → Gen"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"eral → Language: 中文 / English);
- a frame-wide toast after a boot-time auto-update — pure-JS plugins"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" hot-reload in place, plugins with native modules ask for a restart.
- **hot reload** — installing/u"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"pdating/uninstalling a pure-JS plugin applies it to the running process immediately and refreshes th"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"e page; no restart needed. Plugins shipping native modules (`.node`) are detected and prompt for a r"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"estart instead.
- **boot-safety net on every install** — a pre-install dependency audit plus an auto"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"matic post-install boot-composition check with rollback, so a broken plugin can never leave the prof"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"ile unbootable (see Safety net)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**The catalog is this repo's own `data/plugins.json`** — anyone can add a plugin by opening a pull r"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"equest (see Submitting a PR). - ⭐ Stars and 🕓 last c"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ommit are fetched live from the GitHub API; the maintenance tile is colored: green = pushed within 3"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" months, amber = within a year, red = older / archived.
- **Not installed** → `Install` button (inst"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"alls via the npm package).

See How to get a token. The `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` environment variables take precede"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"nce. Saving an empty box never clears a stored token; use the `Clear` button to remove it.
- **Auto-"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"update installed plugins on startup** — when enabled, the web server checks installed plugins after "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"boot and updates any with newer versions; pure-JS plugins hot-reload in place, native ones show a re"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ates any with newer versions; pure-JS plugins hot-reload in place, native ones show a restart toast."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Safety net"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Installing a bad plugin that bricks DSH at the next boot is the deadliest failure mode for a market "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tool. `dsh plugin` automatically mounts **every dependency that declares `dsh.bundle`** as its own p"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rofile layer, so "kitchen-sink" aggregate plugins (e.g. the `dsh-web-ui` family) routinely duplicate"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" loader entries (`duplicate loader entry id: ui-skin-center`) and kill the whole process on startup."},{"id":"p21s5","text":" The workshop defends against this on three levels:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"1. **Pre-install dependency audit (bundle fan-out detection)** — before installing, the target's dep"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"endency tree is fetched and every package that also declares `dsh.bundle` is listed. If "fan-out" is"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" detected (one plugin would enable many profile layers at once), a clear warning is shown and the in"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"stall requires an explicit "I understand the risk" confirmation.
2. **Post-install boot-composition "},{"id":"p22s5","text":"check (the authoritative gate)** — after `pnpm` finishes and before any hot-apply, the new bundle st"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ack is composed in a throwaway subprocess with the *exact same* loader/include machinery the real bo"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"ot uses (`scripts/compose-check.mjs`). Duplicate loader ids, invalid config, and missing packages al"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"l surface there.
3. **Automatic rollback** — when the check fails, the profile's `package.json` is r"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"estored from a pre-op snapshot and the package is uninstalled; the task shows "auto-rolled back" wit"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"h the reason. The profile is **never left in an unbootable state**, no matter what was installed."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"There is also an **offline repair script** for profiles that are already broken (e.g. a plugin insta"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"lled from the CLI directly):"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"It repeatedly runs the composition check and removes non-base bundle layers until the profile compos"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"edly runs the composition check and removes non-base bundle layers until the profile composes again."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How to get a GitHub Token"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. Go to <https://github.com/settings/tokens> (Settings → Developer settings → Personal access token"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"s).
2. Click **Generate new token (classic)**.
3. Give it a name (e.g. `dsh-plugin-market`), set an "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"expiry.
4. Tick the **`repo`** scope (that is all this plugin needs).
5. Click **Generate token** an"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"d **copy it now** (it is shown only once).
6. Paste it into the workshop **Settings** modal and pres"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"s **Save**. A `✓ Token saved (···xxxx)` line appears once a token is stored."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"> Keep the token private — it grants write access to your repositories."}],"truncated":true}
